theme_strategy.name: Industrial Command Center (Data-Dense & Technical)
theme_strategy.mode: Light (Optimized for dual-monitor data work, reduces glare during long analytical sessions)
theme_strategy.description: A strict, high-contrast, data-dense interface designed for supply chain planners. Values precision and density over whitespace. Mimics the feel of a technical schematic or Bloomberg Terminal.

typography.instructions: Use Chivo for page headers, widget titles, and high-level metrics. Use Inter for general UI text. CRITICAL: You MUST use JetBrains Mono (or similar monospace) for ALL numeric data inside tables, MRP explosions, and quantities to ensure decimal alignment. Enable tabular numerals if using standard fonts.

colors.instructions: Color is function. 95% of the UI should be monochrome (white, grays, black). Reserve colors EXCLUSIVELY for state indicators (Blue = Draft, Green = Locked, Amber/Red = Shortage/Warning). Never use generic gradients.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts or 1px solid borders for all panels.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or maximum 4px radius (rounded-sm) for inputs/buttons. No soft or pill shapes.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None. Use flat 1px borders to separate overlapping elements (Neo-brutalist / Technical layout). Remove default Shadcn shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional: Extremely subtle noise texture on the main background to cut the digital flatness.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B). The screen must be utilized edge-to-edge. No massive padding. Use tight gaps.
layouts.page_structure: 3-Pane or Split Layout. Top: Sticky Header (Date Range, Plan Status, Lock Action). Left/Right Sidebar: Sales Plan Context & Lock History. Center Main: Dense Data Table (Draft) OR MRP Explosion Tree (Locked).
layouts.spacing: Minimize vertical padding in data rows (py-1 or py-2 maximum). Planners prefer seeing 50 rows over 10 rows with generous padding.

components.data_tables: Use extremely dense HTML tables. Sticky headers. Pin the first column (SKU/Item) if scrolling horizontally. Row text should be text-sm or text-xs. All numerical columns MUST be right-aligned.
components.the_lock_action: CRITICAL: Do NOT use a simple standard button. The 'Lock Plan' action must feel weighty. Implement a Shadcn Dialog that requires the user to manually type 'CONFIRM' to execute the lock, paired with a warning message ('This freezes the plan for downstream MRP'). Use a contrasting color (Warning or Critical) for the final commit button.
components.mrp_tree: For the MRP Explosion, use a collapsible nested table/list (tree-grid style). Indent child components and use 'L' shaped border lines (SVG or CSS left/bottom borders) to visualize dependency and traceability back to the parent PO.
components.status_badges: Use sharp, rectangular badges. Text-xs, uppercase, tracking-wider. e.g., [ DRAFT ], [ LOCKED ], [ SHORTAGE ].
components.sales_plan_panel: A dense reference panel showing which items are driven by 'AMS/Forecast' vs 'Trailing-Average'. Use compact list items or a summary grid.

motion.rules: Utilitarian and functional only. Fast, snappy transitions (150ms) for UI states. Disable universal transition properties. Use Framer Motion only for accordion expansions in the MRP tree to keep context.
motion.libraries: framer-motion (for the MRP drill-down tree smooth height expansion).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure high contrast. Black text on white/gray. APCA compliant. Critical warnings must be visible for color-blind users (use icons alongside colors).
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'btn-lock-plan', 'modal-confirm-lock', 'row-mrp-expand', 'tab-explosion').

media.icons: lucide-react. Recommended icons: Lock, Unlock, GitCommit (for traceability/explosion nodes), Table, History, AlertTriangle. Set strokeWidth to 1.5 for a technical look.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left-align all content. Add 'text-left' to root.
Prioritize data density. Supply chain planners hate scrolling and whitespace. Pack the information tightly but keep it readable using JetBrains Mono for numbers.
For the 'Lock' action, implement a distinct UI pattern. A standard Shadcn button is insufficient. It must be a deliberate, two-step dialog.
Use Shadcn UI components but aggressively override their default styles: remove rounded-md, remove shadows, tighten padding (h-8 instead of h-10 for inputs).
All numerical columns in tables MUST be right-aligned to allow visual magnitude comparison.
Do not use generic stock imagery. This is a hardcore data application. Visual interest should come from layout precision and typography, not pictures.
Implement conditional rendering: If Plan is DRAFT, show the Production Plan grid. If LOCKED, show the MRP Explosion grid as the primary focus, with the locked plan as read-only.
Always provide realistic mock data (SKUs, PO numbers like 'PO-49291', Safety Stock quantities) to demonstrate the layout properly.
